  ensures ((not (x < lo)) or (result == lo))
  ensures ((not (x > hi)) or (result == hi))
  ensures ((not ((x >= lo) and (x <= hi))) or (result == x))

  example (clamp(7, 7, 7) == 7)
  example (clamp(-8, -5, -2) == -5)
  example (clamp(-1, -5, -2) == -2)
{
  if (x < lo) then lo else if (x > hi) then hi else x
}

fn index_of(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Int
  requires contains(xs, x)
  ensures (((result >= 0) and (result < len(xs))) and (xs[result] == x))
  ensures forall i in 0..result: (xs[i] != x)
  effects pure
  example (index_of([4, 7, 9], 7) == 1)
  example (index_of([3, 3, 3], 3) == 0)
  example (index_of([1, 2, 3, 2], 2) == 1)
  example (index_of([5], 5) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then 0 else (1 + index_of(t, x)) }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == count(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (count_of([1, 2, 2, 3], 2) == 2)
  example (count_of([], 4) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then (1 + count_of(t, x)) else count_of(t, x) }
}

fn beats_all(all: List[Int], rest: List[Int], m: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(rest) >= 0)
  ensures (result == (forall x in rest: ((x == m) or (count(all, x) < count(all, m)))))
  effects pure
  example (beats_all([1, 2, 2, 3], [1, 2, 2, 3], 2) == true)
  example (beats_all([1, 2, 2, 3], [1, 2, 2, 3], 1) == false)
  example (beats_all([1, 2], [], 1) == true)
{
  match rest { [] => true [h, ..t] => (((h == m) or (count_of(all, h) < count_of(all, m))) and beats_all(all, t, m)) }
}

fn mode_ok(xs: List[Int], r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((not result) or ((len(xs) == 0) == (r == None)))
  effects pure
  example (mode_ok([1, 2, 2, 3], Some(2)) == true)
  example (mode_ok([1, 2, 2, 3], Some(1)) == false)
  example (mode_ok([1, 2, 2, 3], Some(7)) == false)
  example (mode_ok([], None) == true)
  example (mode_ok([], Some(1)) == false)
  example (mode_ok([1], None) == false)
{
  match r { None => match xs { [] => true _ => false } Some(m) => ((count_of(xs, m) > 0) and beats_all(xs, xs, m)) }
}

fn find_mode(xs: List[Int], candidates: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires ((len(candidates) >= 0) and (len(xs) >= 0))
  ensures match result { None => true Some(m) => beats_all(xs, xs, m) }
  effects pure
  example (find_mode([1, 2, 2, 3], [1, 2, 2, 3]) == Some(2))
  example (find_mode([5], [5]) == Some(5))
  example (find_mode([1, 2], []) == None)
{
  match candidates { [] => None [h, ..t] => if beats_all(xs, xs, h) then Some(h) else find_mode(xs, t) }
}

fn most_frequent(xs: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires ((len(xs) == 0) or (exists m in xs: forall x in xs: ((x == m) or (count(xs, x) < count(xs, m)))))
  ensures ((len(xs) == 0) == (result == None))
  ensures mode_ok(xs, result)
  effects pure
  example (most_frequent([1, 2, 2, 3]) == Some(2))
  example (most_frequent([]) == None)
  example (most_frequent([5]) == Some(5))
  example (most_frequent([3, 1, 3, 2, 1, 3]) == Some(3))
{
  find_mode(xs, xs)
}

  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == k)
  ensures forall i in 0..k: (result[i] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (take([1, 2, 3, 4], 0) == [])
  example (take([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) == [1, 2])
  example (take([1, 2, 3, 4], 4) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (take([], 0) == [])
{
  if (k == 0) then [] else match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([h] ++ take(t, (k - 1))) }
}

fn drop(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - k))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  effects pure
  example (drop([1, 2, 3], 1) == [2, 3])
  example (drop([1, 2, 3], 3) == [])
  example (drop([1, 2, 3, 4], 0) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (drop([], 0) == [])
{
  if (k == 0) then match xs { [] => [] [_, ..t] => drop(t, (k - 1)) } else xs
}

fn rotate_left(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..(len(xs) - k): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  ensures forall i in 0..k: (result[((len(xs) - k) + i)] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 1) == [2, 3, 4, 1])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 3) == [4, 1, 2, 3])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 0) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 4) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (rotate_left([], 0) == [])
  example (rotate_left([5, 5, 7], 2) == [7, 5, 5])
{
  (drop(xs, k) ++ take(xs, k))
}

fn has(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, v))
  effects pure
  example (has([3, 9, 1], 9) == true)
  example (has([3, 9, 1], 4) == false)
  example (has([], 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == v) or has(t, v)) }
}

fn greater_count(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures ((result == 0) or (exists x in xs: (x > v)))
  ensures ((result > 0) or (forall x in xs: (x <= v)))
  effects pure
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 3) == 1)
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 9) == 0)
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 1) == 2)
  example (greater_count([], 5) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h > v) then (1 + greater_count(t, v)) else greater_count(t, v) }
}

fn is_second(xs: List[Int], r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((r != None) or (result == (len(xs) < 2)))
  effects pure
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(3)) == true)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(9)) == false)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(1)) == false)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(7)) == false)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], None) == false)
  example (is_second([4], None) == true)
  example (is_second([4], Some(4)) == false)
  example (is_second([], None) == true)
{
  match r { None => match xs { [] => true [_, ..t] => match t { [] => true _ => false } } Some(v) => (has(xs, v) and (greater_count(xs, v) == 1)) }
}

fn second_largest_helper(xs: List[Int], checked: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires (((distinct(xs) and distinct(checked)) and (forall x in checked: has(xs, x))) and ((len(xs) <= 1) or (len(checked) > 0)))
  ensures is_second(xs, result)
  effects pure
  example (second_largest_helper([3, 9, 1], [3, 9, 1]) == Some(3))
  example (second_largest_helper([5, 2, 3, 4], [5, 2, 3, 4]) == Some(4))
  example (second_largest_helper([4], []) == None)
{
  match checked { [] => None [h, ..t] => if (greater_count(xs, h) == 1) then Some(h) else second_largest_helper(xs, t) }
}

fn second_largest(xs: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures is_second(xs, result)
  effects pure
  example (second_largest([3, 9, 1]) == Some(3))
  example (second_largest([4]) == None)
  example (second_largest([]) == None)
  example (second_largest([5, 2]) == Some(2))
  example (second_largest([1, 2, 3, 4]) == Some(3))
{
  match xs { [] => None [_, ..t] => match t { [] => None _ => second_largest_helper(xs, xs) } }
}

  ensures (result == contains(xs, v))
  effects pure
  example (has([3, 9, 1], 9) == true)
  example (has([3, 9, 1], 4) == false)
  example (has([], 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == v) or has(t, v)) }
}

fn greater_count(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures ((result == 0) or (exists x in xs: (x > v)))
  ensures ((result > 0) or (forall x in xs: (x <= v)))
  effects pure
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 3) == 1)
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 9) == 0)
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 1) == 2)
  example (greater_count([], 5) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h > v) then (1 + greater_count(t, v)) else greater_count(t, v) }
}

fn is_second(xs: List[Int], r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((r != None) or (result == (len(xs) < 2)))
  effects pure
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(3)) == true)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(9)) == false)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(1)) == false)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(7)) == false)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], None) == false)
  example (is_second([4], None) == true)
  example (is_second([4], Some(4)) == false)
  example (is_second([], None) == true)
{
  match r { None => match xs { [] => true [_, ..t] => match t { [] => true _ => false } } Some(v) => (has(xs, v) and (greater_count(xs, v) == 1)) }
}

fn second_largest_helper(xs: List[Int], checked: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires (((distinct(xs) and distinct(checked)) and (forall x in checked: has(xs, x))) and ((len(xs) <= 1) or (len(checked) > 0)))
  ensures is_second(xs, result)
  effects pure

  example (second_largest_helper([5, 2, 3, 4], [5, 2, 3, 4]) == Some(4))

  match checked { [] => None [h, ..t] => if (greater_count(xs, h) == 1) then Some(h) else second_largest_helper(checked, t) }

fn has(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Bool

  ensures (result == contains(xs, v))
  effects pure
  example (has([3, 9, 1], 9) == true)

  example (has([], 1) == false)

}

fn greater_count(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures ((result == 0) or (exists x in xs: (x > v)))
  ensures ((result > 0) or (forall x in xs: (x <= v)))
  effects pure
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 3) == 1)
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 9) == 0)
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 1) == 2)
  example (greater_count([], 5) == 0)
{

fn is_second(xs: List[Int], r: Option[Int]) -> Bool

  ensures ((r != None) or (result == (len(xs) < 2)))
